claim_scope: Test exact inverse-S3 partner support on Q1481's full cyclic-window factor bases and Q1482's frozen public points. The first solver gate is a fully unpinned known-satisfiable N83 four-point relation; only an independently verified ordinary N83 relation supplies a successful ordinary PDP-stage cost. This is not a complete IC solve or N131 2^x.
parent_inputs: Q1482 byte-identical six CNFs, target-preimage lists, public points and planted fixtures; Q1486's byte-identical window-selector sidecars and exact Q1481 N53/N83 bases

point_decomposition.chain: balanced three-S3 chain, unchanged Q1482 CNF
point_decomposition.solver_family: CaDiCaL plus exact inverse-S3 partner support over cyclic-window leaf domains
point_decomposition.theory_delta: For a fixed nonzero midpoint u and one nonzero leaf x, compute the at-most-two roots y of S3(x,y,u)=0 by the existing exact batched root kernel, then test each y against the other leaf's full partial cyclic-window domain without enumerating that domain. For u=0, test the unique partner y=1/x. Scan the smaller leaf domain as the anchor, up to 4096 actual distinct x values. Derive the first midpoint roots from the fixed second midpoint and target x, and apply the same partner oracle on both leaf pairs. Guard an unsupported-state clause by the assigned target selector, both midpoint rows, all assigned leaf coordinates and window selectors. Preserve Q1482 CNF and the inherited exact root/model checks; omit Q1486's bounded left/right pair-domain enumeration in this variant.
point_decomposition.soundness_basis: S3 is symmetric in its three x variables. For fixed nonzero x and u, solving S3(x,u,y)=0 returns every possible y in the full field; intersecting those roots with the other leaf's exact existential cyclic-window completion rule is equivalent to exhaustive pair enumeration. When u=0 and x is nonzero, S3(x,y,0)=0 exactly when y=1/x. A guarded rejection therefore excludes no valid completion of the current SAT trail.
point_decomposition.decision_order: target selector; one positive cyclic-window selector per leaf; second midpoint; coordinates of one anchor leaf per pair until each has at most 4096 distinct nonzero completions; remaining coordinates and first midpoint

controls: Exhaustively compare the inverse-partner oracle to direct S3 pair enumeration over a small binary field for partial affine windows, assigned selector states, zero and nonzero midpoints, and nonzero leaves.
Compare native inverse-partner support to direct S3 enumeration on deterministic N53/N83 partial domains, including a large unrestricted partner domain.
Both pinned N53/N83 public-point controls must independently replay as four-distinct-column relations.
success_gates: Commit this design and open its stacked PR before implementing or running the variant.
Freeze source, binary, checked Sage runtime, exact input and sidecar hashes, limits, small-field and native equivalence controls, and PS1 stage IDs before the six runs.

Archive all six statuses, including failures and timeouts, with anchor counts, inverse root calls, membership checks, SAT operations, field arithmetic, stage wall intervals, peak RSS and independent public-point replay.
A planted success is a correctness control. Only a verified ordinary N83 relation supports a successful N83 PDP-stage cost; a frozen ordinary panel is still needed for yield and rank.
Keep complete N131 2^x null and the challenge gate closed until all IC phases are charged in one named unit.
